datasets.name: AddInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   D.ROWID,
   D.ID , 
   D.CURRENCY , 
   C.DESCRIPTION , 
   A.BOOROWERID , 
   A.NAME , 
   A.COUNTRYCODE , 
   A.BANKRUPTEYSTATUS , 
   A.PHONENUMBER , 
   A.ADDRESS , 
   A.FIRSTOWNERID ,
   A.FIRSTOWNERNAME , 
   A.SECONDOWNERID , 
   A.SECONDOWNERNAME , 
   A.THIRDOWNERID , A.THIRDOWNERNAME ,
   B.PLEDGENAME , 
   B.HOLDERNAME , 
   B.HOLDERADDRESS , 
   B.ANYINFOTODISTING , 
   B.REGISTRYNO ,
   B.REGISTRYAGENCY , 
   B.REGISTRYDATE , 
   B.PLEDGEINUSE , 
   B.PLEDGEINSURANT , 
   B.INSURANCEAGENCY ,
   B.INSURANCEAMOUNT , 
   B.INSURANCEDATE , 
   B.PLEDGEID , 
   E.VAL_NAME
FROM
   CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS D
 , CM_PLEDGES C
 , CM_BOOROWERINFO A
 , CM_GUARANTEE B
 , SB_AVALUTE E
WHERE
     (D.ID =:CREDITID) 
 AND (D.ID = B.CREDITID)
 AND (D.ID = A.CREDITID)
 AND (B.PLEDGEID = C.ID)
 AND (E.VALUTE = D.CURRENCY)
